quiz.0.question: In what year was Barolo's MGA system officially implemented?
quiz.0.explanation: The Barolo MGA (Menzioni Geografiche Aggiuntive — Additional Geographic Mentions) system was formally established in 2010, codifying 181 individual vineyard sites across Barolo's 11 communes.
quiz.1.question: Giacomo Conterno's legendary Monfortino wine actually comes from which MGA?
quiz.1.explanation: Giacomo Conterno's Monfortino Riserva — often called Italy's greatest red wine — comes from the Francia vineyard in Serralunga d'Alba, a Conterno family-owned MGA.
quiz.2.question: How many official MGAs does Barbaresco have?
quiz.2.explanation: Barbaresco has 66 official MGAs across its three core communes (Barbaresco, Neive and Treiso) — compared with Barolo's 181, reflecting the smaller production zone.
quiz.3.question: When an MGA name appears on a label, what typographic rule must be followed?
quiz.3.options.0: The MGA name must appear in italics
quiz.3.options.1: The MGA name must be no larger than half the font size of the appellation name (Barolo/Barbaresco)
quiz.3.options.2: The MGA name must appear in red text
quiz.3.options.3: The MGA name must appear below the vintage
quiz.3.explanation: Italian labelling rules state that the MGA name must be no more than half the font size of the main appellation name (Barolo or Barbaresco) — to prevent any geographic mention from overshadowing the appellation itself.
